## Added

- Account access-token authentication for saved One Click actions and account cloud services.
- Automatic DreamView sync-center detection from device metadata and account topology.

## Changed

- Unified transport selection under **Cloud Authentication & Control**.
- **LAN first** is the default: local control takes priority, with cloud services used when required.
- **LAN only** disables cloud discovery, authentication, polling and control.
- **Cloud** disables LAN discovery, polling and control.
- Saved One Click actions are discovered automatically using their names in Govee Home.

## Fixed

- Preserve Home Assistant discovery during temporary cloud synchronization failures.
- Keep One Click availability aligned with the account connection.
- Apply the selected transport mode consistently to device controls, scenes, segments, DreamView and raw command replay.
